component.name: Tempus
component.summary: A focused Pomodoro timer for GNOME

description.p: Tempus is a Pomodoro timer designed for GNOME. Stay focused with customizable work sessions and breaks, and manage your tasks with the built-in todo list that supports Markdown import and export.

ul.li: Focus, Short Break, Long Break, and Custom session types
Focus sessions toggle between 25 and 50 minutes, with the matching break lined up automatically
Automatic session cycle with long-break suggestions
Todo list with Markdown file import and export
Imported tasks can carry a pomodoro estimate, a subject and a note
Checking off an imported task writes the change back to its source file
Desktop notifications and sound alerts on session start and end

screenshot.caption: Focus session with the todo list open

GNOME Shell panel widget during a focus session
Panel widget menu during a short break

description.p: Focus sessions now toggle between 25 and 50 minutes right from the main page. Picking 25 minutes lines up a short break when the session ends; picking 50 lines up a long break.

Todo lists now sync both ways. Check off a task that was imported from a Markdown file and Tempus writes the change straight back to the checkbox it came from, so the file on disk and the app never drift apart.

Markdown import now carries more than a checkbox. A task can declare how many pomodoros it should take with a [3🍅] prefix, and the badge tracks progress against it. Subjects are picked up from the surrounding headings and matched against the ones you already have, so an imported list arrives already colour-coded. Anything you indent under a task becomes its note, shown as the row subtitle, and both titles and notes now wrap to the window width instead of being cut off.

A GNOME Shell panel widget shows the running session and countdown right in the top bar, with a coloured dot for the current session type. Click it to start, pause, reset, skip or switch session without opening the app. The timer is now also controllable over D-Bus.
Real audio files replace the synthesised chime for the session-end alert, and a new sound plays when a session starts. The start sound can be turned off in Preferences under Notifications.
Subjects are now colour-coded. Each subject has its own colour, shown as a dot next to tasks and used in the per-subject stats bars. Pick or change a subject's colour in Preferences.
Alert sound replaced with a short ascending chime (do-mi-sol-do). Volume control added in Preferences under Notifications.

Subjects and long-term history. Assign a subject (Math, Physics, Literature…) to any task — custom subjects supported. The stats page now covers Today, Week, Month and Semester ranges. Today still breaks down by task; longer ranges show time per subject. Semester view defaults to the last six months, with an option to set a custom date range in Preferences. Also fixes sound alerts on session end and data not persisting under Flatpak.
Window title now shows the live countdown and session name while the timer is running or paused.
Code cleanup: removed leftover section-divider comments from preferences and window modules.
Tasks now persist between sessions. Activate a task to track focus sessions per task, with pomodoro badges and a daily stats view. Do Not Disturb syncs automatically with focus sessions.
Add preferences menu button to the header bar.
